name: slingshot-game
description: 引力跳板：星际弹弓轨道规划游戏

scripts.dev: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = python -c \"import socket;s=socket.socket();s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));print(s.getsockname()[1]);s.close()\"; $env:PORT=$p; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; Start-Process ('http://127.0.0.1:'+$p); python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port $p"
